title: Experiences Building Edge TPU with Chisel
summary: A Google talk from the Chisel community in which engineers recount designing the Edge TPU with the Chisel hardware construction language. It covers the productivity gains and the problems they hit.
why: Pointed to as a rare first-hand account of a real, shipping ASIC built in an open-source HDL, useful in HDL and FPGA choice discussions.

quote.text: Google had a really interesting talk on their experiences with Chisel in designing the first Edge TPU chip.
